value.rationale: An exact natural classification of all endomorphisms and retracts of arbitrarily heterogeneous finite products of bi-Gödel chains, with a combinatorial support criterion and rank-refined counts even under cardinality collisions. Unlike qualitative product decomposition, it calculates all image-size multiplicities and proves that arbitrary endomorphisms and idempotents attain the same ranks. Nontrivial mixed lengths expose the effect of the full bi-Heyting signature, and the uniform specialization recovers transformation-monoid enumerations.
